locations.name: Mountain World
locations.description: You stand at the base of a tall, snow-capped mountain. A trail winds its way up to the peak.

locations.name: Water World
locations.description: You have reached the peak of the mountain. The view from here is breathtaking. To the north, you see just water.

locations.name: Box World
locations.description: Tall, dark trees surround you. The sounds of wildlife echo all around. There's a path that leads deeper into the boxy woods.
